Method of Attack: Malware operators use underground forums to hire money mules who launder stolen funds
Transfer funds from hacked bank customer accounts to mule-controlled accounts
Disperse stolen funds to multiple accounts for withdrawal via ATMs or purchase of expensive products
Money mule gangs keep part of the funds while malware groups get their cut
Indicators of Compromise: Arrests of money mules in London, Daventry, West Bromwich
Seizure of cash, computers, smartphones, false identity documents
Use of underground forums for hiring and advertising money mule services
